The structure of Lu2Co6Ge2 (LuCo3Ge) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives each Co center 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Ge and Lu each have 8 Co neighbors; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Co 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Co–Ge polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
